falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes more than 4% above or below its level at the start of the 14-day window on any session, with the move confirmed by a second close beyond that threshold
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A resolved directional trend of that size falsifies UNKNOWN/HOLD: the regime is no longer undecided and sitting out missed a clear move

falsification_conditions.condition: Pattern-match similarity to bottom_2024_aug falls below 50% or rises above 90% and stays there for 3 consecutive sessions
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The analog either breaks (below 50%, so the bottom template no longer applies) or confirms (above 90%), so an unresolved UNKNOWN call is no longer tenable

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints above 70, or high-yield OAS widens by more than 50 bps from the start of the window
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Either a blowoff regime or a credit-stress regime has replaced the current non-call, invalidating both the low blowoff reading (38) and the HOLD

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
